problem:
Let $N$ be the set of all functions of the form $f(x)=a|x|,$ where $a\in R.$ Which of the following statements are true?

- For any $f(x)\in N,$ we have $(-1)\cdot f(x)=f(x).$
- For any $f(x)\in N$ and $\alpha ,\beta \in R,$ we have $(\alpha +\beta )f(x)=\alpha f(x)+\beta f(x).$
- For any $f(x),g(x)\in N$ and $\alpha \in R,$ we have $\alpha (f(x)+g(x))=\alpha f(x)+\alpha g(x).$
